source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies adaptive honest confidence sets for sparse regression under observed designs and relates feasibility to separation and composite testing.
The paper studies bootstrap confidence sets for covariance spectral projectors based on i.i.d. centered observations.
The work studies minimax expected-measure confidence sets under restricted parameter spaces and Bayes-minimax duality.
The paper develops adaptive confidence intervals for linear functionals using between-class and ordered moduli, including nonconvex parameter spaces.
The paper develops rank-sparsity incoherence and characterizes identifiability and deterministic recovery conditions for sparse-plus-low-rank decompositions.
